name: Direct Evidence for Neutrino Flavor Transformation from Neutral-Current Interactions in the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory
title: Direct Evidence for Neutrino Flavor Transformation from Neutral-Current Interactions in the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory

claim.quote: Direct Evidence for Neutrino Flavor Transformation from Neutral-Current Interactions in the Sudbury Neutrino Observatory

summary.plain: Using a method that counts every kind of neutrino equally, not just the electron kind, SNO proved directly and without relying on solar models that solar neutrinos really do change type on their way to Earth.
summary.technical: Neutral-current-based measurement of 8B solar neutrinos: electron-flavour component 1.76±0.05(stat)±0.09(syst) ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1; non-electron-flavour component 3.41+0.45/-0.45(stat)+0.48/-0.45(syst) ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1, 5.3 standard deviations above zero; total NC flux 5.09 (+0.44/-0.43 stat, +0.46/-0.43 syst) ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1, consistent with solar models.

why_it_matters.value: Solar-model-independent, direct proof of solar neutrino flavour transformation, resolving the decades-old solar neutrino problem.
why_it_matters.quote: 5.3 standard deviations greater than zero, providing strong evidence for solar electron neutrino flavor transformation

key_value_text.value: Non-electron flux 3.41 ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1, 5.3σ > 0; total NC flux 5.09 ×10^6 cm^-2 s^-1
key_value_text.quote: 3.41+/-0.45(stat.)+0.48,-0.45(syst.) x10^6/(cm^2 s), 5.3 standard deviations greater than zero
